You're very welcome, Noah! I'm glad I could help you with both changing the shipping address to your New York address and modifying the watch from silicone strap to metal strap with white dial.

Your order #W4219264 is all set and will be processed with the updated items and shipping address. The $121.20 refund will be processed to your Mastercard within 5-7 business days.

If you need any assistance with this order or anything else in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a great day!

您的订单#W4219264已经准备好，将使用更新后的商品和运送到您的纽约地址进行处理。121.20美元的退款将在5-7个工作日内处理到您的Mastercard。

如果您需要对此订单或未来任何其他事项的帮助，请随时联系我们。祝您今天愉快！
